payload.text: No Molt bats at all on rhadamanth, not even a single bats file, while Utilz 2.14.2 is dry-run and cut (utilz-vc, 19:09Z: slot 251, utilz-dc's dry run with a 3600 s kill timeout, then hv's cut; its wrapper counts every bats process on the host). Releases when utilz-vc sends molt-vc the cut's END by name and intent-vc clears a slot; vc then runs the full suite under both bashes, pushes Molt and Molt-matts (0040 to 0042: Molt 2cfb1b4 431dc10 066305c 4af30b0 8e58acc; Molt-matts 3220359 fec83d1), and gives dc and cc the all-clear.
